THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
163
STUDY 132
Burgundy Cutout Gown
Rights check
Source: 25018.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, loose blonde
waves stands indoors near a pale wall and a wood
floor. She wears a fitted burgundy strapless maxi dress
with horizontal sheer cut-outs at the midriff. Gold
bangles stack on her wrists, and a small gold pendant
sits at her throat. Her expression is calm and direct.
Soft, warm interior light. Palette of burgundy, cream,
and warm gold. Glamorous and sleek, in the style of an
evening wear campaign.
Glamorous, sleek, modern
WORKING NOTES
- The sheer cut-outs and bangles are the defining details.
- Keep the wood floor for a warm, lived-in setting.
